authority: Non-authoritative research. Current Master Spec, HBR and signed WP/MT contracts govern adoption.

scope.product: Handshake (Product): research/design only; no product implementation, build, test or GUI proof.
scope.repo_governance: Repo Governance: this assigned JSON only; durable docs stay in gov_kernel.
scope.assessed_scope: All pinned manifests and root declarations; selected actual execution bodies deeply inspected. Individual codec/effect kernels and professional Adobe parity are not certified.

execution_roots.title: Entrypoint, commands and staged edit history
call_chain: native main -> Session::default -> file.open -> Session::execute -> CommandSpec.run
timeline command -> edit_sequence_as -> staged Project/EditorState -> Sequence.check -> commit/history/revision
verified_logic: The command registry unifies UI/CLI/control/MCP dispatch; enabled checks and panic-to-error conversion exist.
edit clones document and selection state and replaces them after closure success. Merged edits coalesce interactive changes.
execute synchronizes persistence and publishes live snapshots after Result errors. Its panic guard does not restore a command-wide prior document.
adoption_gaps_and_controls: Separate edit/command contracts from the engine facade.
Use one Studio canonical document/history owner with agent-specific view/selection, expected revision and idempotency receipts. A Session per agent would fork authority.
Define a multi-stage command commit point and rollback/compensation for earlier edits and external writes; catch_unwind alone is insufficient.

execution_roots.title: Timeline arithmetic and trim transaction
call_chain: FrameRate/ticks -> timeline selection -> insert/overwrite/split/extract -> clamp_trim -> trim cloned Sequence -> work.check -> replace
verified_logic: Ticks use 254016000000 per second and integer rational conversions. Source trim/retiming also uses f64 speed and rounding.
Insert/overwrite validate target track locks. Insert and extract include sync-lock tracks and captions.
trim refuses conflicting sync-lock overlap, leaves linked partners to the caller and commits only after Sequence validation.
adoption_gaps_and_controls: Bound imported ticks, duration arithmetic and allocation IDs; do not claim every retime is rational/exact.
Exercise reverse/freeze/VFR/drop-frame/nondividing rates, linked-group edits and multi-hour timelines.
Roll/slip/slide and group trim declarations are censused; only the stated trim/split/insert/extract bodies were deeply traced. Exact gesture parity remains unproven.

execution_roots.title: Multicam synchronization and live cuts
call_chain: multicam create -> selected media metadata -> sync anchors -> placements -> camera tracks/audio policy -> MulticamSource
live angle cut -> Recorder.base Project -> apply_pass -> edit_merged -> stop -> final pass
verified_logic: In/out, timecode, marker and audio methods are implemented. Audio analysis takes at most 30 minutes at 48000 Hz.
Creation orders camera/video roles, chooses Camera1/All/Switch audio policy and retains sample timing before optional frame alignment.
Live cuts reconstruct a pass from a base Project. Duplicate cut timestamps are normalized by edit/multicam.
adoption_gaps_and_controls: Lease the affected sequence or commit revision-checked patches so live recording cannot replace unrelated concurrent edits from its base snapshot.
Record source sync provenance, correlation/confidence, selected reference, angle/audio intent and exact timing in receipts.
Test staggered starts, midnight timecode, mixed rates, long takes, audio-only angles, nested sources, reconnect and angle revisions.

execution_roots.title: File readers, codec factories and GOP cache
call_chain: Services.reader/open_file -> container reader or byte fallback -> MediaSource -> global/builtin codec factory -> GOP frame_late -> cache/seek/decode/flush
verified_logic: Streaming readers exist. Probe whole-file fallback is capped at 64 MiB.
Process-global registered factories precede builtins; the first Some result is returned even when it is an error. Software-only fallback bypasses registered factories.
GOP logic seeks from sync samples, bounds extra decode, checks cancellation, caches PTS and returns nearest decoded frame at or before requested PTS if exact output is absent.
Pool constants retain four idle decoders, up to eight recent decoders, with 500 ms recent and three-second idle thresholds. Recently active layers can exceed count thresholds.
adoption_gaps_and_controls: Receipts must distinguish requested PTS, actual PTS, approximate fallback, draft and proxy state.
Make decoder/container implementations selectable; codecs facade currently pulls many engines unconditionally.
Use governed immutable registry/capability ownership instead of per-agent process-global registration.
Count thresholds are not total-memory ceilings; enforce CPU/RAM/VRAM/in-flight admission and content-aware source identities.

execution_roots.title: Offline media, proxies and relink
call_chain: media_key -> cached source -> proxy/full-res -> offline/pending/open-error Slate
relink -> sampled identity -> candidate metadata/timecode/duration -> one edit
proxy start_job -> immutable tasks -> transcode -> completed outputs -> poll -> attach/replace
verified_logic: File media cache keys use path/offline state; generator keys contain parameters.
Missing or unreadable media supplies a logged slate. Pending fetch slates are not cached. Export uses a full-resolution provider.
Proxy fallback can use original audio when proxies contain fewer streams, and falls back to original if proxy open fails.
Relink supports sampled size/head/tail fingerprint, filename/extension/duration/timecode/metadata checks and candidate ranking.
Proxy jobs retain successful outputs if a later task fails; poll applies those completed outputs as partial progress.
adoption_gaps_and_controls: Do not claim relink has no identity support: sampled identity is implemented, although it is not a full content hash and cache keys remain path based.
Bind completion to document revision, item identity, original media fingerprint and generation; reject or quarantine stale ItemId-only results.
Require partial-success receipts and reject slate/silence in strict final delivery unless deliberately accepted.
Check proxy audio maps/timecode/HDR/rotation/PAR/content identity, not duration/frame rate alone.

execution_roots.title: Picture render, effects, captions and color
call_chain: render_sequence -> render_seq_tracks -> transition/adjustment/active item -> item_layer_ex -> media_frame/base_layer -> colorman -> effects/masks/motion -> blend -> display/captions
Pipeline.frame -> render -> placement/overlays -> HDR float or SDR byte conversion
verified_logic: Transitions, adjustment regions/effect/opacity masks, placement and blending have actual implementations.
Source color overrides and cached transfer/gamut/tone transforms exist, with separate display conversion.
Nested rendering has a depth guard; over-depth returns the empty canvas.
media_frame discards video_frame errors into None. Missing layers are skipped and transition inputs default to empty images. Pipeline.frame returns image data rather than an error-capable outcome.
Frame blending can keep the first frame when the second fails or dimensions differ.
adoption_gaps_and_controls: Strict delivery must receive typed source/render loss instead of accepting every image return as success.
Expose node/source timing, actual PTS, profile/color intent and loss state through Argus and diagnostic adapters.
Separate CPU rendering and GPU plans/device leaves. Independently verify alpha, pixel reference, HDR/mastering and nested captions.
This review does not audit every effect kernel or certify Adobe color/effect matching.

execution_roots.title: Audio graph and playback clock
call_chain: source.audio_stream -> time warp/nest -> clip gain/channel/pan -> effects
mix_graph_at -> Plan::build -> tracks/inserts -> submix/master -> layout/meters
UI playback -> play_ahead::spawn -> bounded SPSC ring -> device callback -> played frame counter
verified_logic: Clip automation uses an absolute 64-sample grid for chunk-boundary consistency.
Mixer plan includes track/submix/master inserts, pre/post sends, routing, latency and preroll state; submix direction prevents feedback loops.
Audio source errors become None in the render path.
Desktop play-ahead uses a 200 ms lead, 1024-frame blocks, channel clamp 1..64 and atomic SPSC ring. Callback copies/zero-fills and counts underruns; producer skips elapsed silent spans.

Non-f32 device conversion reuses scratch but can allocate through try_reserve/resize on the callback and emit eprintln on failure. The core ring callback is allocation-free; not every enclosing driver callback is.
adoption_gaps_and_controls: Preserve bounded callback pattern; preallocate conversion buffers and move failures to atomic diagnostics.
A mixer panic is logged while playback continues silently; expose failed worker state in addition to missing-frame counters.
Measure callback deadlines, underruns and clock drift on x64 product and ARM authoring targets. Static code is not realtime proof.
Strict audio delivery needs source-error propagation, sample count/channel/loudness/true-peak and stem/turnover proof.

execution_roots.title: Stepped render, encode, mux and delivery
call_chain: job -> immutable Project/full-res source -> Exporter::step -> render_batch -> encode_batch/audio pull -> mux/flush -> Out.finish -> Report
prefetch -> rayon scope -> encoded progress -> cancel/Pending/Done
verified_logic: Settings/dimensions are validated. Adaptive overlap batches, cancellation, Pending retry, two-pass encoding and flush are implemented.
512 MiB in-flight limit measures two output-frame batches only; max(1) admits one frame even if it exceeds the fit. Float workspaces, decoder references and other jobs are outside it.
encode_batch pulls audio before checking Pending. AudioOut::pull advances next_in/out and mutates limiter state, so retry can lose that audio span.
File::create targets the requested output directly; finish flushes and reports metadata bytes. This path does not stage atomic publication or independently decode/verify the output.
adoption_gaps_and_controls: Preserve stepped/cancel APIs; do not describe them as absent. Propagate deadlines/cancellation into all parallel decode/effect work with explicit or RAII context.
Stage audio cursor/DSP state until batch commit or restore it on Pending.
Use shared admission budgets covering oversized frames, codec refs, CPU/GPU workspaces, audio, prefetch and concurrent jobs.
Stage outputs and publish atomically after mux/readback/frame/sample/time/color checks; quarantine cancelled and partial files.

execution_roots.title: Hardware adapters and software replay
call_chain: platform::register -> device/profile probe -> hardware factories
hybrid decode -> bounded replay/emitted PTS -> hardware error -> builtin software replay/dedup -> resume
verified_logic: Platform branches include macOS VideoToolbox, Windows Media Foundation/NVENC and Linux VA/NVENC.
Hybrid fallback bounds replay by samples/bytes, deduplicates emitted PTS and handles HEVC CRA reference retention.
Availability probes show callable support, not certified profile/device/realtime fidelity.
adoption_gaps_and_controls: FFI/OS/GPU implementations must be selectable leaves behind shared media/frame contracts. Broad platform codec/export dependencies are not cheap leaves.
Pin device/driver/profile/bit-depth/color choices in receipts; independently verify fallback replay output.
cfg branches and Rust source do not prove ARM/x64 compatibility or hardware encode fidelity.

execution_roots.title: Native save/load/autosave and interchange
call_chain: file.open -> Services.read_file -> format::decode -> schema/migration -> validate_loaded -> install -> relink
file.save -> name/view serialization -> Services.write -> native atomic writer
autosave snapshot -> debounced worker -> separate snapshot/meta writes
detect/import -> EDL/FCP7XML/FCPXML/OTIO/AAF/OMF -> Report -> media resolution
verified_logic: Native schema migration and version/numeric bounds are implemented; newer unsupported versions are rejected.
Load truncates excessive audio streams and substitutes stream zero for invalid indices with log warnings; structural broken projects remain repairable.
Native atomic_write uses adjacent create_new temp, sync_all, rename and best-effort directory sync; export output uses a different direct-write path.
Save changes project name before writing; no command-wide failure rollback exists. Autosave snapshot/meta are separately atomic files.
Interchange returns warning reports. Generic AAF/OMF import_with warns when embedded audio is not extracted.
Complete .rs/.md/.toml PRPROJ search found only a forbidden-fixture-extension list; no native PRPROJ decoder/root or Format variant exists in this pin.
adoption_gaps_and_controls: Native Premiere PRPROJ import remains an explicit Handshake OPEN_GAP. XML/OTIO/EDL/AAF alternatives do not fulfill or narrow it.
Studio format must preserve unknown nodes/assets/original native bytes and expose every conversion loss or substituted stream.
Bind autosave snapshot/meta by document/revision/content identity and test crashes between writes.
Use bounded parsing/decompression and unresolved-reference/loss-aware conversion. Full binary AAF/OMF traversal was not deeply audited here.

execution_roots.title: Remote tools, visual inspection and swarm pressure
call_chain: MCP/bridge -> serialized socket -> ControlRequest UI queue -> engine/UI command
FrameServer -> cache/in-flight dedupe -> per-view coalescing -> worker cancellation context -> render/cache
ui.elements/timeline hit/locate/screenshot -> visual observation
verified_logic: Desktop control limits lines to 4 MiB and open connections to sixteen but creates an unbounded std mpsc UI channel; transport timeout does not cancel queued requests.
Bridge retries twice after transport failures and creates a new request ID each attempt; echo IDs are not an idempotency fence.
Frame requests dedupe exact keys and coalesce priority-zero target/size requests, but reviewed push_back has no global admission cap.
Workers cache noncancelled/nonloading results and expose structured timing/stats.
UI requests can raise an occluded window. Observation/screenshot is not intrinsically background-only.
adoption_gaps_and_controls: Use bounded queues, Backpressure/RetryAfter/Busy receipts, actor quotas and fair resource admission; adding shared locks alone does not solve swarm pressure.
Single-writer commits, immutable read snapshots and disjoint patch/conflict arbitration retain safe parallel pure work.
Require idempotency, actor attribution, expected revision, cancellation acknowledgement and durable result lookup. Do not replay mutations after unknown completion without lookup.
Expose reused widget semantics and revision-bound offscreen captures through Argus with crop/scale/profile/proxy/draft/time/revision/loss provenance and quiet observations.

modularity_findings.finding: Many packages still hide broad closures: engine has eighteen direct internal dependencies, codecs pulls software containers/decoders unconditionally and UI pulls engine/GPU.
modularity_findings.adoption: Extract proven leaves; split document/time/edit contracts from source/decode/render/export/device/tool adapters. Do not create an all-Studio engine facade.

modularity_findings.finding: audio-dsp, bitstream, cfb, matroska, mxf, ogg, opus and golden have no normal dependencies; time/geom/color depend only on serde.
modularity_findings.adoption: Candidate low-closure seams, not acceptance verdicts. Preserve attribution and verify malformed inputs/fidelity per leaf.

modularity_findings.finding: Software codecs have thread features; codecs aggregator has no per-format capability features. Platform uses OS/FFI dependencies.
modularity_findings.adoption: Select codec/container packages independently; keep oracle runners out of product closures. Measure cold/warm critical-path and linking costs before speed claims.

modularity_findings.finding: EffectCraft pins FilmCraft 2c5ba7a72619935f0481f99d59409e0d1844b234; this Film pin is 7b6c134472287db4367fca80bcb498240ba36567.
modularity_findings.adoption: Do not unify packages by matching names. Validate one lineage against API/types/serialization/color/time behavior; the old Film revision was not downloaded or diff-audited here.

modularity_findings.finding: Default whisper is off; optional Candle inference and model download features exist.
modularity_findings.adoption: Exclude AI/model download implementation per Operator scope and avoid its baseline dependency closure.

professional_workflow_proof_gaps.workflow: Long-form documentary/series offline edit, multicam and conform
professional_workflow_proof_gaps.required_proof: Multi-hour mixed-rate/nested footage; locked/sync-lock linked/split edits; over-depth diagnostics; stale originals/proxies; midnight timecode/VFR/PAR/interlace; conform losses; one Studio document.

professional_workflow_proof_gaps.workflow: Broadcast/cinema SDR/HDR delivery, stems, captions and archive
professional_workflow_proof_gaps.required_proof: Independent decoded frame/sample counts/PTS; mastering/color/alpha/bit-depth/profile metadata; captions and text safe; true peak/loudness/stems; cancellation/no partial publication; unavailable media fails strict delivery.

professional_workflow_proof_gaps.workflow: Native Premiere conversion and round-trip loss review
professional_workflow_proof_gaps.required_proof: PRPROJ decoder is absent here. Authored-native fixtures, retained originals/opaque structures, source/master/nest/proxy/template/effect/audio/caption dependencies and loss mapping remain mandatory.

professional_workflow_proof_gaps.workflow: Audio post turnover, reconform and review
professional_workflow_proof_gaps.required_proof: Source sample handles/channel maps/BWF-iXML; AAF/OMF media extraction; reconform IDs/timecode; loudness variants, mismatch reports and exact result inspection; no Audition-equivalence claim.

professional_workflow_proof_gaps.workflow: Parallel agents editing and inspecting while the human edits
professional_workflow_proof_gaps.required_proof: Fair bounded CPU/RAM/VRAM queues; revision conflicts; no lost/duplicated writes; no focus/window raises; cancelled or stale previews cannot serve as proof; exact document/frame receipts.

adoption_controls.requirement: Every Studio MT maps HBR, source pin/license/files, changed contracts, build closure, Argus/Flight Recorder/Palmistry adapters, fixtures and independent acceptance proof. Root owns signed MT/spec state.
Reuse one panel/widget asset family with stable IDs/semantics/commands/visual snapshots; do not duplicate FilmCraft docks or create separate apps per repository.
Single-writer commits and immutable reads; bounded queues, explicit admission/backpressure, quotas/cancellation and fair independent processing rather than one universal engine lock.
Typed codec/render loss, preview-vs-delivery policy, explicit native conversion losses and preserved originals. Reuse upstream Report/telemetry/pending/cancel concepts through governed interfaces.

licensed_and_unsafe_boundaries.source_license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 workspace. Retain NOTICE. Separate branding/font/media provenance; this is not a complete transitive license audit.
licensed_and_unsafe_boundaries.dependencies: Symphonia MPL-2.0 audio bootstrap; optional external Craft fonts; OS codec/GPU libraries are separate device/dependency boundaries.
licensed_and_unsafe_boundaries.unsafe: Workspace default forbids unsafe. Platform isolates OS FFI with lint overrides. Desktop CPAL/window/GPU/device adapters do not prove Rust-only portability.
licensed_and_unsafe_boundaries.required: Audit resolved crate licenses/native libraries/font/asset attribution per pinned extracted leaf.

proof_state.oracle_caveat: ffmpeg/ffprobe macros may return without assertions when missing. Missing/ignored/unavailable oracle fixtures are NO_PROOF, not PASS. Upstream oracle fixture defaults use repo target; adapt governed external artifact paths before execution.

provenance.extraction: Python tarfile filter=data into exact new commit directory; no overwrites/deletes/upstream commands.
provenance.file_manifest_hash_algorithm: SHA256 of sorted UTF-8 POSIX path + TAB + file SHA256 + newline
provenance.archive_limit: Complete regular-file commit snapshot, not git history/external fonts/oracle downloads/dependency sources. No .gitmodules/.gitattributes found.
provenance.gameplan_gate: Explicit shared studio-preparation-gameplan.yaml before_dispatch PASS 15/15, GAMEPLAN_ROLE=kernel_builder before acquisition.

workspace.inspection: Manifest and declaration census, not Cargo resolved graph or measured build speed.
workspace.closure_method: Union of nonoptional normal and target-specific internal dependencies; build/dev separate, actual target/features can prune this conservative union.
